name: What kitchen upgrades improve accessibility for homeowners with mobility needs?

mainEntity.name: What kitchen upgrades improve accessibility for homeowners with mobility needs?

acceptedAnswer.text: Common accessibility upgrades include widening door openings, lowering countertop sections, installing pull-out cabinet shelving, and adjusting switch heights. Custom framing can open up tight entryways, while wheelchair-accessible layouts provide open clearance beneath sinks and prep surfaces. Transition-free tile flooring helps eliminate trip hazards between the kitchen and adjoining dining or living spaces, creating a safer environment for family members with mobility challenges.
acceptedAnswer.description: Key upgrades include widening doorways, installing roll-under sink counters, adding pull-out shelving, and laying flush, slip-resistant tile flooring.
